metadata.description: Reviewed context for Claude Code: every plugin has a REVIEW.md and evals

plugins.name: notify-done
plugins.description: When several sessions run in parallel: a system notification as soon as Claude has finished its turn and is waiting. Costs nothing.

plugins.name: context7
plugins.description: Pulls up the current documentation of libraries. Just RAG over current, continuously updated documentation. Almost always pays off.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: When the project is on GitHub: the agent opens PRs and issues itself, reads reviews and the logs of failed Actions

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: When you need short answers: cuts the preamble and the articles, keeping code, errors and warnings about dangerous operations. More experimental

plugins.name: claude-api
plugins.description: When the project calls the Claude API: current model ids and prices, adaptive thinking, caching, tool use, model migrations. Pays off in any code on the Anthropic SDK

plugins.name: docx
plugins.description: When you need to fix up a .docx (touch up a CV, produce a solid report with tables)

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: When you write or edit an Agent Skill: interview, draft, running evals with subagents, picking a description.
